In Indiana, Trump's net approval rating slipped underwater in Civiqs' polling in late June, after being positive throughout his second term. It now stands at -3.

Similarly, in Mississippi, his net approval, which had been positive during much of his second administration, has been in negative territory since May. [...] Nationally, 35 percent of voters approve of Trump's job performance while 59 percent disapprove as of August 19, leaving him significantly underwater with a net approval rating of -24, according to Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters.
